description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Evaluation Context Length and PPL for different values of γ. The x-axis represents Evaluation Context Length, with a logarithmic scale, ranging from 2K to 64K, and tick labels at 2K, 4K, 8K, 16K, 32K, and 64K. The y-axis represents PPL, with a linear scale, ranging from 7.7 to 8.1, and tick labels at 7.7, 7.8, 7.9, 8.0, and 8.1. Three lines are shown: a blue solid line with circle markers representing γ=0.25, an orange dashed line with circle markers representing γ=0.5, and a green solid line with circle markers representing γ=0.75. The blue line starts at approximately 8.25 at 2K, decreases to around 7.83 at 4K, then increases slightly to 7.86 at 8K, before decreasing again to 7.81 at 16K, and then remains relatively stable, ending at around 7.81 at 64K. The orange line begins at approximately 8.25 at 2K, decreases to around 7.83 at 4K, and continues to decrease to 7.73 at 8K, 7.72 at 16K, and 7.71 at 32K, before leveling off. The green line starts at approximately 8.25 at 2K, decreases to around 7.83 at 4K, and continues to decrease to 7.73 at 8K, 7.72 at 16K, and 7.71 at 32K, before leveling off.
